description: Main application code for Bluetooth Heart Rate Service client using Zephyr RTOS, handling device discovery, connection, and notifications.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth and starts device scanning.

methods.name: start_scan
methods.description: Starts BLE scanning with active scan parameters.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles successful connection; initiates service discovery.

methods.name: notify_func
methods.description: Handles GATT notifications and unsubscription events.

methods.name: discover_func
methods.description: Processes discovered GATT attributes, manages service and characteristic discovery, and subscribes to notifications.

methods.name: eir_found
methods.description: Processes advertising data to find Heart Rate Service UUID and initiates connection.

methods.name: device_found
methods.description: Handles device discovery events during scanning.
